notes.title: Epic Clicker Journey - Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Dear Players!
We are glad to announce you we updated Epic Clicker Journey to version 1.3!
In this update we added:

	Dungeon - new location with endless mode, it allows players to collect gold and experience. Dying there has no impact to gold, loot and fellow
	Leaderboard based on scores achieved in Dungeon
	35 new active items which helps discover different play styles
	Increased amounts of fellows slots
	21 new achievements
	Cheaper keys in the shop
	New Game option which allows players to start their journey again (it resets all besides Diamonds)
	Icons for items which have impact to the game
	Stats summarizer which lets player know his output stats
	For those who don't like Multiplayer we added option to turn it off
	A few more minor improvements and fixes


We hope you will like it so we can work harder to finish mobile version of the game :)) Good luck guys!

notes.title: Epic Clicker Journey - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we introduce another minor update which contains a few improvements and fixes. We are following Community Discussions to know what thigs you would like to see in the furture and what bugs are driving you crazy so we can click! click! click! them out of our game :)

Features
	Added tooltips so players can now get more information on certain functionalities (i.e. Items)
	Added Active Items icons above Experience bar. Icons can be used to activate items
	Added hotkeys (keys 1-9 and 0 as 10) to use Active Items. Hotkeys are currently autoassigned basing on order in Player sockets
	Now every active item usage will be visible for every Player in Multiplayer location
	Added new items: #NewBorn, #LikeAPhoenix, #RescueCD


Bug fixes and adjustments

	Fixed bug when last enemy appeared after location finnish
	Fixed bug when only first enemy appeared in each location
	#GetXPFromKey now gives 250 XP instead of 10
	#SacrificeThem gives now 5 times Fellow DPS instead of 1:1
	#ScareThem changed to consumable

notes.title: Epic Clicker Journey - Update to v1.1
notes.notes:
Taking into account great reviews and feedback from all of you guys, we are working hard to make Epic Clicker Journey more adequate to your needs. It was only one day since the game was released and we had already managed to add first crucial improvements for making your gaming experience better. The list of changes that will be implemented in the future is much longer, but for now we would like to share with you the following enhancements.

Features

Added a possibility to return to lower map levels, to allow players to get back and grind. To do so, player will have to click on a proper skull in the right bottom corner of the map.


Bug fixes and adjustments

Fixed "All for one" achievement bug which prevented players from getting this achievement after finishing Multiplayer location.
Temporary fixed the issue preventing players from unlocking new locations. The fix is temporary due to necessity of game restart. Currently we are working on the full fix of this bug.
Increased number of player's lobbies, so players will meet each other more often.
Reduced players gathering time from 10 to 5 seconds.
Added "Sell" word to equipped items, so players will no longer accidentally sell their stuff.


Edit
We fixed problem with unresponsive map after changing map level, sorry for inconvenience
